description: Show where you are in each course's modules and the next items you still have to do: what each one needs (open it, turn it in, a minimum score), when it's due, and what is locked and why. Read-only. Use it for "what's next in my classes?" Gives module_id and item_id for mark_module_item_done.

course_id.description: Only this course (from list_courses). Leave it out to check your active courses, up to 10.

per_course.description: How many next items to show for each course, 1 to 10. Default 3.

name: next_module_items
title: Next Module Items
